# PerchTV 0.1.14

Nothing changes on this television. This version carries the same number as PerchTV on Samsung televisions, which changed.

## WHAT CHANGED

- Nothing on this television. PerchTV's television apps share one version number, so a change on one kind of television moves the number on all of them. This release changes the Samsung app only: holding the fast-forward or rewind key there now moves the picture at 8 times normal speed, forward or back, and stops the moment you let go. The left and right keys keep their skips.

## WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything, including pairing, casting, play/pause and stop, the skip keys (10 s back, 30 s forward, hold for two minutes a second), the connection check every 45 seconds, and the update check on every start.
